about: Native builds' budgets (tools/bench/native_bench --check; tools/regress.sh perf). Times: the fastest of the runs' CPU time of the built program, start-up included; a budget missed fails. "budgets" were measured on an Apple M4 Max busy with other lanes' builds, "systems" holds a system's own (by platform.system()). Measured 2026-11-05 (NATIVE-ARRAYS, docs/speed-audit-2026-11.md "Native typed arrays"): before typed arrays (every element a boxed Value) dsp_voices 135 ms, dsp_params 102 ms, arrays 42 ms, byte_array 23 ms, dsp_scalars 10 ms; after 12, 13, 12, 6, 10 ms. The budgets leave room for a busy machine and fail when an array goes back to Values. Linux's are the Mac's times 2.5 (the ratio vm_budgets.json measured for a one-core Ubuntu VM), not measured yet.
